title: FDA Says It Is Speeding Up The CBD Regulation Process

blocks.html: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) said on Friday that it was “expediting” its efforts to develop rules for CBD and plans to issue a report on the department’s progress by early fall. To read more on this story, head here: https://www.marijuanamoment.net/fda-says-it-is-speeding-up-the-cbd-regulation-process/
